title: Checks for string slices immediately followed by as_bytes.
summary: It involves doing an unnecessary UTF-8 alignment check which is less efficient, and can cause a panic. Clippy puts this lint in the perf group, at the level warn.

title: Checks slow zero-filled vector initialization
summary: These structures are non-idiomatic and less efficient than simply using vec![0; len]. Clippy puts this lint in the perf group, at the level warn.
